title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
name_bilingual: 剥取、采集动作与获取加快 / Faster Carving, Gathering, and Acquisition
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Static 59 - Faster Carving, Gathering, and Acquisition

preimages.meaning: 中文：把共享 1.1 获取倍率重定向到已有 1.5 常量。 / English: Redirect the shared 1.1 acquisition multiplier to an existing 1.5 constant.
中文：把共享 1.3 动作倍率重定向到已有 2.0 常量。 / English: Redirect the shared 1.3 action multiplier to an existing 2.0 constant.

known_risks: 中文：精确替换共享剥取/采集动作倍率 1.3→2.0 与获取倍率 1.1→1.5；动画与实际结算可能在少数动作上不同步。 / English: Exactly redirects the shared carve/gather action multiplier 1.3→2.0 and acquisition multiplier 1.1→1.5; animation and settlement timing may diverge for a few actions.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：直接把共享剥取/采集动作倍率从 1.3 提到 2.0，并把获取结算倍率从 1.1 提到 1.5，使剥取、采集和拾取流程整体更快。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Directly changes the shared carve/gather action multiplier from 1.3 to 2.0 and acquisition multiplier from 1.1 to 1.5, speeding carving, gathering, and pickup flow. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
